steps.body: Sometimes the total is known and one addend is hidden. Build what you can, then find the gap up to the total.
steps.narration: Sometimes the total is known and one addend is hidden. Build what you can, then find the gap up to the total.

widget.prompt: A ten is already made and the total is 15. Count on from 10 to reach 15.

commonLandings.feedback: That stops one short of the total; keep going until you reach it.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 10 and count on 5: you land on 15.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 15 — the five hops are exactly the missing addend.

predict.prompt: A ten is built and the total is 15. Is the missing addend bigger or smaller than 15?

options.label: Smaller — it is only a part

predict.reveal: A part can never exceed its own total, so the missing addend fits inside 15.

widget.prompt: A learner knows the total is 17 and has built 12 already. Start at 12 and count on 5 to find the missing part.

widget.missFeedback: Count from 12 to 17: five hops fill the gap.
widget.successFeedback: Exactly — 5 is the missing part because 12 plus 5 is 17.
